name: chat_v1
description: Fixed conversational evaluation for M5 (written before SFT training, frozen by SHA-256). Every reply is checked for format (ends with <|end|> before the token limit, no role tokens, non-empty) and, where objectively checkable, for content with simple case-insensitive string rules. 'open' items have no content check; they measure stopping and repetition only.

checks.include_any: reply contains at least one of the strings (case-insensitive)
checks.exclude_any: reply contains none of the strings (case-insensitive)
checks.max_words: reply has at most this many words
checks.max_sentences: reply has at most this many sentence-ending marks (. ! ? followed by space or end)
checks.min_list_items: reply has at least this many lines starting with '-', '*', '•' or a number followed by '.' or ')'
